The Moon is winking at Jupiter and Venus today.

The Moon in Gemini makes friendly angles to Jupiter at lunchtime and Venus this evening, then slips into Cancer tonight. Swipe for Aries, Leo and Sagittarius, plus one question to journal on today.

Save this for tonight, or send it to your Fire friend. 🌙
